def transform(grid):
    a=[row[:] for row in grid]; H=len(a); W=len(a[0])
    from collections import Counter, deque
    bg=Counter(v for row in a for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    # Components, 4-connected
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    for r in range(H):

              seen.add((yy,xx)); q.append((yy,xx))
        comps.append((col,cells))
    # A long corner-shaped component sets its color and the inward quadrant.
    key=None
    for col,cells in comps:
      rs=[r for r,c in cells]; cs=[c for r,c in cells]
      h=max(rs)-min(rs)+1; w=max(cs)-min(cs)+1
      if len(cells)<6 or h<3 or w<3: continue
      # seek a large orthogonal L component: at least one full bbox edge run in both axes
      rows={r:sum(y==r for y,x in cells) for r in set(rs)}
      cols={c:sum(x==c for y,x in cells) for c in set(cs)}
      # choose end runs as vertical/horizontal arms; current task has stem at top and arm along bottom
      if min(cs) in cols and cols[min(cs)]>=h-1 and max(rs) in rows and rows[max(rs)]>=w-1:
        key=(col,cells,(max(rs),min(cs)),1,-1); break # open lower-left
    if key:
      color,cells,(cr,cc),dr,dc=key
      choices=[]
      for col,pts in comps:
        if col==color: continue
        cy=sum(r for r,c in pts)/len(pts); cx=sum(c for r,c in pts)/len(pts)
        # only components in the concave quadrant, score distance along both axes
        if (cy-cr)*dr>0 and (cx-cc)*dc>0:

      if choices:
        pts=max(choices,key=lambda z:(z[0],z[1]))[2]
        for r,c in pts:a[r][c]=color
    return a
